<?php
class Base157Review {}
class Named157Review {
    public function __toString(): string { return "named"; }
}
$replacement157Review = new class {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "new-call|"; return "new"; }
};
$receiver157Review = new class extends Base157Review {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $receiver157Review, $replacement157Review;
        echo "old-call|";
        $receiver157Review = $replacement157Review;
        return "old";
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "old-dtor|"; }
};
$following157Review = new class {};
echo $receiver157Review::class, "|", $following157Review::class, "|";
echo $receiver157Review instanceof Stringable ? "stringable|" : "missing|";
echo "(", $receiver157Review, ")|", $receiver157Review, "|after";

<?php
function late157Review() { echo "late|"; return "R"; }
$value157Review = new class {
    public function __toString() {
        echo "throw|";
        throw new Exception("conversion");
    }
};
try {
    echo "echo|", $value157Review, late157Review();
} catch (Exception $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
$destination157Review = 99;
echo "concat|";
try {
    $destination157Review = $value157Review . late157Review();
} catch (Exception $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo $destination157Review, "|after";

<?php
$object157 = new class {
    public $calls = 0;
    public function __toString() {
        echo "cast|";
        $this->calls++;
        return 12;
    }
};
echo $object157 instanceof Stringable ? "stringable|" : "bad-interface|";
echo $object157, "|", $object157->calls, "|";
$result157 = $object157->__toString();
echo $result157 === "12" ? "string|" : "bad-return|";
echo $object157->calls, "|after";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$destination157 = "kept";
$object157 = new class {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo "body|";
        return 17;
    }
};
try {
    $destination157 = (string) $object157;
    echo "bad|";
} catch (TypeError $error157) {
    echo $error157->getMessage(), "|", $error157->getLine(), "|";
    echo $destination157, "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
$source157 = 'namespace String157Author;
function make157() {
    return new class {
        public $tag = 1;
        public function __toString(): string {
            echo "body|";
            return "unit" . $this->tag;
        }
    };
}';
eval($source157);
$first157 = String157Author\make157();
$second157 = String157Author\make157();
$first157->tag = 4;
$second157->tag = 5;
echo $first157 instanceof Stringable ? "stringable|" : "bad-interface|";
echo $first157, "|", $second157, "|after";

<?php
echo "unreachable|";
$object157 = new class {
    public function __toString(): int { echo "bad-body|"; return 17; }
};

<?php
$object157 = new class {
    public function __toString() { echo "empty|"; }
};
try {
    echo $object157;
    echo "bad|";
} catch (TypeError $error157) {
    echo $error157->getMessage(), "|", $error157->getLine(), "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
$object157 = new class {
    public function __toString(): never { echo "never|"; }
};
try {
    echo $object157;
    echo "bad|";
} catch (TypeError $error157) {
    echo $error157->getMessage(), "|", $error157->getLine(), "|";
}
echo "after";
